What changed.

A screenshot walkthrough of the real FinanceBot application. This page documents results; it contains no scoring forms or separate evaluation workflow.

Generation quality is not yet proven.

The configured model API returned HTTP 429: “You have no credits remaining.” No model-generated question succeeded. A stale-source gate, exact Bank-duplicate check, role boundaries and TA scrolling were verified locally.

Visible in your existing workspace

The authoring page now offers source and question-memory checks. Admin Operations now exposes model calls and the recorded user workflow. The independent blinded-review demo is not part of this walkthrough.

Backend: evidence packets, Bank/Queue memory, save eligibility, token receipts and request/run links.
Frontend: a pilot switch, run diagnostics, usage details and Admin timeline.

Open generation page ↗Open Admin usage ↗Open TA queue ↗

Local fixture retained for inspection. Use the local IdP admin/admin test persona; Instructor screenshots use faculty with a temporary course grant that was removed after checking.

Original-source evidence → Bank + batch memory → Generate → Numerical / validation / review checks → Source + notation + novelty check → Save eligible Drafts

Opt-in public new generation only. This extends the existing pipeline; no fine-tuning or new autonomous agent framework was added.

Have the original problems been solved?

No blanket “fixed” claim. VERIFIED means observed in this local session. PARTIAL means a mechanism exists but does not establish improved generation quality. OPEN identifies work not delivered in this iteration.

Instructor · see the changes step by step

Open a course → Generate Questions. Check the pilot when creating a new batch. Then open Generation activity → View steps to inspect outcomes, coverage and usage.

LIVE LOCAL UI

1. Start with an assigned source

One authored CAPM note is stored in MongoDB and embedded into Qdrant. It defines beta_i, the CAPM equation and exclusions. This is a synthetic fixture; file upload and parsing were not tested.

Open a course → Generate Questions → Create a batch. The source and question memory pilot is off by default. This screenshot uses the real local Instructor identity.

3. Turn on source and question memory

Check “Sources and question memory pilot”. The batch summary reflects the selected policy. Only new public generation uses this pilot; regeneration and private assessments are not covered.

4. Follow the persisted generation activity

Generation activity shows the task outcome and recorded usage. There were no successful generated questions in this session; the two visible Drafts were manually authored fixtures.

5. Inspect the real provider failure

The baseline generator received HTTP 429: no credits remaining. The failed call was captured; no input/output token totals were invented. Source, notation and semantic-novelty model judgments could not be reached.

Actual FinanceBot screenshot · click to enlarge

LIVE LOCAL UI

6. Verify an original-source protection

Qdrant was deliberately supplied with text different from the original Mongo chunk. The pilot rejected it with generation-evidence-stale-retrieval before generation. Zero observed model calls is known here. The valid index was restored afterwards.

Actual FinanceBot screenshot · click to enlarge

Exact Bank duplicate: locally verified without a paid judge

A direct production-service check loaded 2 actual local Bank/Queue versions. It submitted an exact copy of the seed question to the quality service, which returned status: withheld and novelty: duplicate before model judgment. This checks the deterministic blocker, not the quality of newly generated questions or semantic paraphrase detection.

TA · original scrolling bug

The screenshot bug came from nested scrolling regions. Children could trap wheel input without a bounded scroll height. The current layout gives the TA reader one scroll owner and reserves a separate action footer.

LIVE LOCAL UI

The long question is a manually authored regression fixture, not generated by the unavailable API. It isolates the original scroll issue.

What was actually tested

Real local SAML login, Express endpoints, MongoDB, Qdrant and production browser pages. The walkthrough did not intercept application APIs or mock successful model responses.

Real Instructor reads course usage; Admin ledger is denied

Separate automated checks

Production build passed. Six focused Jest suites passed 97 tests: original evidence, memory, quality-service decisions, worker pipeline, usage accounting and workflow grouping. Model responses in those unit tests are controlled fixtures; these tests do not measure live model quality.

All source content and two manual questions in the walkthrough are authored synthetic fixtures. No uploaded teaching or student data was sent to the provider. Source parsing, successful provider token reporting, regeneration, hard-question quality and a real before/after quality comparison remain untested.

Next work, in priority order

  1. Restore credits or configure a working local provider, then run baseline and pilot against identical source and starting Bank snapshots.
  2. Read the generated questions and verify scope, notation and independent reasoning. Compare accepted Draft supply, tokens and review effort before claiming improvement.
  3. Bring source and Bank memory into regeneration; verify that edit instructions change the requested concept.
  4. Add a justified conciseness policy and address queue selection/order, editor return paths and material/LO overlap as separate product changes.
  5. If required for debugging, implement access-controlled full prompt/response traces; the current ledger contains metadata only.
